Title: LSJ : Damage from Pulled Fangs and aggravated damage ?

Messages.Author: Magnus
Messages.Body:
In case that Wynn enters combat with minion X , which has 5 blood on
him, and hit愀 him for 3 aggravated hand damage and 3 damage from
retainers *and* plays Pulled Fangs on the minion after inflicting the
damage, is the minion considered burned ( 3 aggravated + 3 normal + 1
normal ), or is he already on the way to torpor/ in torpor, and can愒
be affected anymore with the Pulled Fangs ?

Magnus

Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:


he's on its way to torpor (wounded) , and has zero blood on him. Assuming he
cannot prevent anything, the damage from pulled fangs burns him =)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Normal damage won't burn a vampire.

3 agg + 3 retainer (non-agg) damage sends him to torpor, empty.
Then the Pulled Fangs is played and does one more (non-agg) damage
(which he cannot heal, so he's yet again on his way to torpor).

He ends up in torpor, empty (with the Pulled Fangs card).

LSJ> Then the Pulled Fangs is played and does one more (non-agg) damage

Aggro damage is still by far the most confusing part of this game.

So just to make sure, the fact that PF deals the damage at the end of
combat prevents the burn, right? So the sequence goes like this:

1) Minion X getting 3 aggravated (hand strike) and 3 normal
(environmental)
2) The normal damage is applied first. This leaves X at 2 blood.
3) The aggravated damage is then applied. The first point causes X to
become wounded (going to torpor), the remaining 2 points cause
blood to be burned. Result: X is at 0 blood, going to torpor.
4) The damage from PF is applied at the end of the combat round. The
one additional normal damage has no effect, since X is already
going to torpor and has 0 blood.

//Petri
